headwords: cha mẹ sinh con, trời sinh tính

flags.why: The gloss restricts canh chua to a southern tamarind recipe, although [regional versions](https://openlanguage.org.au/wp-content/uploads/2023/05/UoW-am-thuc-VN_May25.pdf) use other souring ingredients.
The entry omits the common meaning 'flooded with; suffused with', especially in [descriptions of sunlight](https://englishsticky.com/tu-dien-viet-anh/chan%20ho%C3%A0.html).
flags.fix: adj | flooded with; suffused with (especially light); ex: Căn phòng chan hoà ánh nắng. = The room is flooded with sunlight.

flags.why: Chang bang is a [Southern regional word](https://vannghemoi.com.vn/phuong-ngu-nam-bo-trong-sang-tac-cua-nguyen-thi/) but has no regional tag.
The gecko sense belongs to [coastal Northern dialects](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/chanh_ch%C3%A1ch) but lacks a regional tag.
